in_sanskrit.name: Kuvira
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful queen
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kuvira एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kuvira is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kuvera’, which means 'powerful' or 'mighty'. In Hindu mythology, Kuvira was the name of a demon queen who ruled over the Naga tribe. She was known for her immense power, intelligence, and cunning nature.
